text: Which of the following statements about the shapes of molecules is correct? I. Ammonia has no lone pair on the nitrogen atom II. The shape of a molecule is determined by repulsion between electron pairs III. All molecules with three atoms are bent
explanation:
The shape of a molecule is determined by repulsion between electron pairs — this is correct.

The other two statements are not true: "All molecules with three atoms are bent" and "Ammonia has no lone pair on the nitrogen atom" both misstate the physics.

So only II is correct.

The other two are true statements about the shapes of molecules.
